title: 3D Printed Treatment Options | The CheckRare Brief | CheckRare
summary:
The FDA has approved a new oral pellet formulation of Orladeyo (berotralstat) for adults and adolescents 12 and older with hereditary angioedema (HAE). 

HAE, is a rare genetic condition that causes sudden, unpredictable episodes of swelling in the skin, the gut, and sometimes the airway, which can be life-threatening.
